request: Analyze GSE310294 for PMID 41555288 (Effect of moderate-intensity treadmill exercise on bone quality in adult rats and the underlying mechanisms.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq of left tibia (bone tissue), Novogene, Illumina
final.organism: Rat (male SD, 16 weeks old at start)
final.sample_inclusion: RNA-seq n = 3 rats per group (Fig. 5 legend); left tibiae
final.primary_estimand: Effect of 6-week moderate-intensity treadmill exercise vs sedentary control on tibial bone gene expression in adult male rats
planned_contrasts: Exercise vs Ctrl (S3.3.p1; paper: 2076 DEGs, 1552 up / 524 down)

paper_threshold.significance_criterion: not_reported (paper states only the fold-change rule); encoded as no p-value filter

final.paper_results: 2076 DEGs (1552 up, 524 down); 39 bone-formation genes up incl. Igf1r, Bglap, Sp7, Smad6, Runx2, Ctnnb1, Col1a1, Pth1r (S3.3.p3); qPCR Runx2 up, Rankl/Trap down; GO/KEGG ORA (FDR < 0.05 for terms), GSEA ECM/osteoblast differentiation enriched in exercise

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S2.6.p1: left tibiae RNA-seq by Novogene, DE with DEGseq, GO/KEGG on DEGs with FDR < 0.05 for terms, GSEA v4.1.0. S3.3.p1: 'classic criteria (Fold Change < -2 or > 2)' gives 2076 DEGs (1552 up / 524 down); no p or q cutoff is stated for genes. Fig. 5 legend: n = 3 rats per group. ABS.p2: male SD rats, 6-week moderate treadmill. The gene threshold is encoded literally as FC-only (no p filter); a significance-filtered audit rule is reported separately.

design.reasoning: One exercise arm and one control arm of independent rats (S3.3.p1, Fig. 5); the paper's only RNA-seq contrast is Exercise vs Ctrl. 3 vs 3.

covariance.reasoning: Independent animals, one tibia sample each; no batch, sex (all male) or other covariate in the metadata or paper.

paper_route.reason: no DEGseq executor in the workflow; DEGseq's MA-plot test is designed for unreplicated data and is not a validated route here

deviations: DESeq2 Wald on raw counts instead of DEGseq; edgeR (TMM) run as sensitivity because GEO data_processing names edgeR

method.reasoning: Raw integer counts support DESeq2. The paper's DEGseq (S2.6.p1) has no executor, so DESeq2 runs as a declared deviation with the paper's threshold; edgeR sensitivity mirrors the GEO processing note.

final.deviation_note: Paper rule (FC > 2 or < -2, no stated p/q cutoff) applied to DESeq2 log2FC; audit adds BH padj < 0.05.

threshold.reasoning: S3.3.p1 states only 'Fold Change < -2 or > 2' -> |log2FC| > 1 (exact, strict); no gene-level significance cutoff is given, so the paper rule is FC-only. Audit rule padj < 0.05 & |log2FC| > 1 shows how many of those also pass significance.

caveats: Paper used DEGseq; DESeq2 runs instead (paper route blocked).
Paper threshold is fold-change only; FC-only counts on DESeq2 MLE log2FC include low-count genes, so the padj audit count is the more reliable number.
Matrix columns are labelled FPKM but hold raw integer counts (decided from values and GEO processing note).
